d: Chhath mahaparv aate hi gharon se lekar ghaton tak ek aavaj gunjne lagti hai. 'uga hai suraj dev, bhaile aragh ke ber' aur 'kanch hi bans ke bahangiya' jaise giton ke bina chhath ki kalpana adhuri lagti hai. in giton ki bat ho to sabse pahle logon ke jehan men padm vibhushan sharda sinha ka nam aata hai. unki surili aavaj ne chhath giton ko aisi pahchan di ki aaj bhi mahaparv ke dauran unke git har taraph sunaee dete hain. lekin kya aap jante hain ki chhath ke in paranprik giton ko rediyo ke madhyam se logon tak pahunchane vali shuruaati aavaj sharda sinha ki nahin, balki bihar ki…
